newsitem.title: USA: Equus affiliate to run Dominican lottery.
newsitem.headline: Equus affiliate to run Dominican lottery.

text.p: Equus Gaming Co LP, a publicly traded partnership with horse racing and gaming interests in the Caribbean, said Monday an affiliate has signed a contract to manage the wagering distribution system for a new national lottery in the Dominican Republic.
Equus said it effectively owns 45 percent of Galapagos SA, which operates V Centenario Race Track and an off-track betting (OTB) agency network in the Dominican Republic.
Galapagos has a contract to provide distribution services for Dominican International Electronic Lottery Inc and will provide and share outlets with LEIDSA's national lottery commencing June 1997.

Galapagos also announced that it has signed a contract with Autotote Systems Inc, a division of Autotote Corp to provide the operating system for the lottery. Autotote also has contracts with V Centenario Race Track and El Comandante Race Track in Puerto Rico.
LEIDSA will pay fees to Galapagos for providing the distribution system and to reimburse Galapagos for approximately one-half the telephone line costs of Galapagos' OTB agencies.
